summary:
ISSUES
Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the web performance test. It is recommended to investigate the cause of this failure and optimize the page to improve its performance.
insights: The pricing page has the fastest load time (255.8 ms) and TTFB (25.3 ms), indicating efficient optimization. Analyzing the factors contributing to its performance can help improve other pages.
The blog page has the longest First Contentful Paint (FCP) time (312.4 ms), suggesting that optimizing the initial rendering of content could enhance user experience.
Reducing the duration of the homepage load time can positively impact user engagement and conversion rates, as it is the first page users typically encounter.
